description: Designs, reviews, and migrates MATLAB R2026a and GNU Octave numerical code, covering functions with arguments blocks, arrays and indexing, tables and timetables, matlab.unittest tests, MATLAB Projects, exportgraphics figures, MAT file inventory, and MATLAB-Python interoperability.
